message.content: Look at why the nightly export fails on large tenants.
It buffers the whole table before writing, so large tenants run out of memory.

Rework the nightly export so it streams rows to the bucket instead of buffering the whole table in memory. The current job holds every row until the end, which is why it runs out of memory on the large tenants and the retry starts again from zero. Keep the file layout the same so downstream readers do not change, write a checkpoint after each chunk so a retry resumes where it stopped, and add a test that exports a table larger than the chunk size and checks the output matches the old format byte for byte. When that passes, run it against the staging copy and tell me how long it took and how much memory it peaked at compared with last night's run, then open the PR and leave it for me to review before merging.
Streaming the export in chunks with a checkpoint after each one.
